title: Bonus Buy Maintenance
subtitle: OMS promotions and their bonus buys. Open a promotion to work on its bonus buys, as in SAP.

access.deniedTitle: No access to Bonus Buy Maintenance
access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the Bonus Buy Maintenance grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

list.loadFailed: The promotions could not be loaded.
list.empty: No OMS promotions yet. Create one to start adding bonus buys.

create.title: Create promotion
create.hint: The promotion number is given when you save.
create.failed: The promotion could not be created.

promotion.title: Change promotion: Bonus Buy Overview
promotion.subtitle: The promotion's header and every bonus buy in it.
promotion.loadFailed: The promotion could not be loaded.
promotion.name: Name
promotion.saveFailed: The promotion could not be saved.
promotion.deleteOnlyEmpty: A promotion can be deleted only when it holds no bonus buys.
promotion.confirmDeleteBody: Delete promotion {{number}}? Its number is never given out again.
promotion.confirmActivateBody: Activate every Tested bonus buy in promotion {{number}}? Nothing goes live while any bonus buy in it is still Planned, or if any one of them is refused.
promotion.confirmDeactivateBody: Deactivate every activated bonus buy in promotion {{number}}? They stop pricing at every till.
promotion.activated: Promotion activated: every Tested bonus buy is live.
promotion.flipRefused: Nothing changed. These bonus buys were refused:
promotion.actFailed: The action could not be completed.

overview.title: Bonus Buys – Overview
overview.empty: No bonus buys in this promotion yet.
overview.testNeedsPlanned: Select at least one Planned bonus buy: only a Planned one can be marked Tested.
overview.testBody_one: Mark {{count}} Planned bonus buy Tested? Mark it only once you have priced the cases you need in the simulator. The server checks it again first.
overview.testBody_other: Mark {{count}} Planned bonus buys Tested? Mark them only once you have priced the cases you need in the simulator. The server checks each one again first.
overview.testSkipped_one: {{count}} selected bonus buy is not Planned and is left as it is.
overview.testSkipped_other: {{count}} selected bonus buys are not Planned and are left as they are.
overview.needSome: Select one or more bonus buys.
overview.confirmDeleteBody: Delete {{count}} bonus buy(s)? Only a Planned or Deactivated bonus buy can be deleted; any other is refused.

copySap.title: Copy from SAP
copySap.label: Bonus buy number
copySap.hint: The bonus buy is copied into a new Planned OMS bonus buy in this promotion. The source is not changed.

upload.title: Upload bonus buys
upload.hint: SAP's bonus-buy upload file (22 columns), tab-separated, unchanged except that its promotion (AKTNR) must be an OMS P number. Uploading the same file again updates the bonus buys it created; it never duplicates them.
upload.omsColumns: The file may also carry two OMS-only columns: 23 SCORE and 24 LOY_TIERS. SAP will not load a file that uses them until they are dropped.
upload.landsPlanned: Uploaded bonus buys always land Planned. A file that reaches a bonus buy which is not Planned is refused whole.
upload.checkOnlyHint: Every row is checked and nothing is written.
upload.failed: The file could not be uploaded.

problem.tooLarge: The file is larger than {{max}} MB.

result.refused: {{file}} was refused. Fix these rows and upload it again.
result.unknown: The answer to the upload could not be read. Check the overview before uploading again.
result.promotionCreated: Promotion {{number}} was created from the file, Planned.
result.promotionWouldBeCreated: Promotion {{number}} would be created from the file.

editor.subtitle: Promotion {{promo}}
editor.loadFailed: The bonus buy could not be loaded.
editor.notFound: Bonus buy {{number}} does not exist. It may have been deleted by someone else.
editor.actFailed: The action could not be completed.
editor.copyRefused: The bonus buy was not copied:
editor.copied: Copied. This is the new Planned bonus buy.

readOnly.display: Display only. Use Change to edit this bonus buy, or Copy to start a new one from it.
readOnly.sap: This is a SAP bonus buy. It can be displayed and copied, never changed here.
readOnly.locked: Only a Planned bonus buy can change. Take it back to Planned to change it; it must then be tested again before it goes live.

check.refused: Check found problems. Nothing was saved.
check.stale: This bonus buy was changed after you opened it. Reload it, then make your change again.
check.notFound: This bonus buy no longer exists.

save.stale: Not saved. This bonus buy was changed after you opened it. Reload it, then make your change again.
save.notFound: Not saved. This bonus buy no longer exists.

line.descriptionPending: Material descriptions are not shown yet. Check and Save still refuse a material that is not in the item master.
line.groupingMissing: Not in this bonus buy's groupings

total.title: Total Discount
total.hint: A Price is a bundle price: the Get lines together cost this much. With an empty Get grid it is the basket's price.

history.none: A new bonus buy has no history yet.
history.pending: Only the last save is shown. The full list of changes needs a server read that does not exist yet.

engine.hint: These are the settings the engine reads that SAP's screen lacks. Leave a field empty for no restriction.
engine.listHint: Paste a column or row from Excel, or separate codes with commas, spaces or new lines.
engine.overCap: Over the {{max}}-character limit. The server will refuse it.
engine.timeHint: Set both or neither. A window past midnight is allowed.

paste.hint: Paste a column or row from Excel, or separate materials with commas, spaces or new lines.

status.activateNeedsTest: A Planned bonus buy must be tested before it can be activated.

test.title: Mark Tested
test.hint: Mark this bonus buy Tested once you have priced it in the simulator. The server checks it again first.
test.notePlaceholder: For example, the basket you tried
test.done: Marked Tested. It can now be activated.
test.notFound: This bonus buy no longer exists.
test.saveFirst: Save your changes first: Mark Tested marks the saved bonus buy.

backToPlanned.confirmTitle: Take a live bonus buy back to Planned
backToPlanned.confirmBody: Bonus buy {{number}} is live. Taking it back to Planned pulls the offer off every till until it is tested and activated again.
backToPlanned.done: Back to Planned. It can be changed now, and must be tested again before it goes live.
backToPlanned.notFound: This bonus buy no longer exists.

couponMaterial.title: New coupon material
couponMaterial.hint: Creates a new redeem-only coupon item with the next COUP number and puts it on this line. Each press makes a new one. Save the bonus buy to keep it on the line.
couponMaterial.done: Coupon material {{material}} created and put on the line. Save to keep it.
couponMaterial.notPlaced: Coupon material {{material}} was created, but its line was removed or changed meanwhile. Type it on a Buy line to use it.
